observations: A horizontal gold-toned rectangular block with four oval recesses sits across the upper-center, flanked by bright white flare points at its left end.
Below the block, two large dark-outlined triangles point downward, filled with pink and white cross-hatching, set against a black band that cuts through the mid-composition.
The background layers olive-green washes, teal patches, red-orange rectangles, and dense zigzag line work in yellow and white across all four edges.
reading: A machine-like horizontal bar anchors the upper field, its oval recesses reading as buttons or dials, while white flares push light outward from the left. Below, two downward triangles carry a cooler, more fragile quality against the dark band. The surrounding zigzag lines and color patches read as noise or static—busy but not chaotic, holding the central forms in charged suspension.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work sits between title neighbors nnxyz nnotb #73 and nnxyz nnotb #75, both of which feature machine-like rectangular forms and white flare light. Title order and recorded creation order align here.
